name: Strategic Stake & Tax Scrutiny
description: A strategic stake purchase re-rates the auto and IT counters, while income-tax raids knock Aravali Pharmaceuticals.

name: July 1991 Rupee Devaluation
description: The rupee is devalued in two steps. Exporters gain, but imported picture-tube costs crush Navrang Electronics.

name: Gulf War Oil Spike
description: Crude spikes as Gulf War supply lines break. Konark Petrochemicals revalues its inventory sharply higher.

name: Political Collapse & Soviet Crisis
description: The government falls and Soviet payments freeze. Steel and pharma slide while peace hopes collapse the oil price.
